integrity.reproducibility: Two independent finite algorithms, deterministic direct byte comparisons at 50 critical endpoint lengths and complete 25-row CSV; no formal independent audit has been performed.

scientific_limitations: The classification is exact only for integer factor lengths 1 through 8192. It uses certified finite substring comparisons, not an infinite recurrence theorem. Unindexed equivalent data remain an originality risk.
title: Exact initial non-repetitive complexity of the Baum–Sweet word through length \(8192\)
